title: Hurricane Harvey Package 2
description:
Army Reserve Soldiers helped distribute water to local community support groups and citizens in need.

(U.S. Army Video by Cpl. Timothy Yao)
keywords: FEMA, Harvey, Army Reserve Command, "hurricane relief", DSLR, Canon 7d, Hurricane Harvey, USARHarvey2017, 644th Transportation Company, Tim Yao, Army Reserve, Houston

transcript.text: I think it makes the Army come out in a positive light because there's a lot of people out there who actually think that you know the first thing they think they see the Army all you know something's bad happening.
Now that they see us in this light now they know they're not just here for the bad things are also here in a good time as well when we actually need them.
We were with Sisterhood's creation in my daughter's school with Barnett Charter School. They need all types of supplies. They lost everything.
So we're trying to get everybody together. These guys are giving us a hand with a lot of means in the world.
There's no water back there. We're closing the loading of the whistle of water so we can pass it to the community.
We're actually at Barnett Charter School today and then Saturday will be at 8505.
We'll be passing out water diapers and other stuff that the community needs.
